pages.text: <name> had a big dream — to fly! One sunny afternoon, with shiny tape, colorful buttons, and a huge round balloon, he built a bubble-shaped rocket in the backyard. “Ready for lift-off!” <name> cheered, hopping inside.
With a gentle whoosh, the rocket floated up into the sky, sparkling like a giant soap bubble. The wind whistled past, and the neighborhood below looked like tiny toy houses and gardens.

Suddenly — spin-spin-spin! The rocket twirled in silly circles, making everyone laugh. Even the dog barked excitedly, wagging its tail. <name> held on tight and giggled at the dizzy spins, watching sparkling bubbles drift in the sunlight.

“Let’s work together,” <name> said to his friends below. They waved ribbons, held a soft blanket, and cheered. Using clever thinking, <name> pressed the right buttons and gently tilted the bubble. With teamwork and careful guidance, the rocket slowly floated down. Plop! It landed safely in the backyard.
Everyone clapped and laughed. “That was twisty and wobbly and so much fun!” said <name>. He realized that sometimes mistakes can lead to the most exciting adventures.
From that day on, <name> dreamed of new bubble-rocket flights, ready for more sparkling spins, whistling winds, and joyful discoveries with friends and pets by his side.
